statements.impact_statement: Golusoris imports no google.golang.org/grpc/xds package and never constructs xds.NewGRPCServer. Govulncheck reports no reachable call path.

The advisory covers the unmaintained package golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp in every release of the module and has no fixed version. No module of this repository has that package in its import graph (31 modules listed with go list -deps -test on 2026-10-18); the policy test rechecks the root and core graphs, and the reachability scan of every module rejects a call into it. Category D, renewed 2026-10-18 after re-review: OSV still lists no fixed version (record modified 2026-07-10).
